panels.description: Input throughput = Σ(in_total) ÷ Σ(latency_sec), tok/s. in_total is the log_llm_usage total input tokens (incl. cache_read; ~99.5% cache hits over the last 24h, so input TPS ≈ cache/prefill read throughput). latency is the llm_usage wall-clock (latency_ms). avg = token-weighted over all calls; max/min = the fastest/slowest agent per bucket (agent_id IS NOT NULL, only buckets with valid calls count).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000

max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

panels.title: Input TPS (avg / max agent / min agent)

panels.description: Output throughput = Σ(out_total) ÷ Σ(latency_sec), tok/s. out_total is the log_llm_usage total output tokens, incl. reasoning (Anthropic thinking / OpenAI reasoning both count into output_tokens; base/lm/usage.py does not add them again) — i.e. pure decode generation speed (~79 tok/s measured over the last 24h). latency is the llm_usage wall-clock (latency_ms). avg = token-weighted over all calls; max/min = the fastest/slowest agent per bucket (agent_id IS NOT NULL, only buckets with valid calls count).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000

max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

panels.title: Output TPS (avg / max agent / min agent)

panels.description: Gen-stage output throughput = Σ(out_total) ÷ Σ(decode_sec), tok/s. decode_ms is the 2026-08-04 new instrumentation (stream last chunk − first chunk arrival, excluding network/queue/prefill); out_total is the log_llm_usage total output tokens (incl. reasoning). Only calls after the decode_ms instrumentation went live are counted (attributes ? 'decode_ms'); non-streaming fallback / empty-stream calls with decode_ms=NULL do not count. avg = token-weighted over all calls; max/min = the fastest/slowest agent per bucket (agent_id IS NOT NULL, only buckets with valid calls count).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_decode_ms [5m])) * 1000

max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_decode_ms [5m])) * 1000)

min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_decode_ms [5m])) * 1000)

panels.description: Memory-search store row count (absolute state, 60s sample) into the ava_memory_search_stats_rows_ratio gauge (task #2088); thresholds: 30k soft warning / 50k backend-switch evaluation / 100k hard cap.
panels.title: Memory search rows

panels.description: Duration of the most recent npz save (ava_memory_search_stats_last_save_seconds, task #2088); absent until the first save after boot — a climbing value flags a slow save path.
panels.title: Memory search npz save duration

panels.description: Projected full-day LLM spend from usage-time cost snapshots over the dashboard time window. Formula: window spend × 86,400 / elapsed seconds in the panel range.
panels.title: LLM cost estimate — day pace

panels.description: Projected 30-day LLM spend from usage-time cost snapshots over the dashboard time window. Formula: window spend × 2,592,000 / elapsed seconds in the panel range.
panels.title: LLM cost estimate — 30-day pace

panels.description: Usage-time LLM cost snapshots grouped into $__interval buckets, normalized to a per-minute USD rate (bucket sum / interval seconds * 60).
panels.title: LLM cost / minute

panels.description: Top 20 models by windowed usage-time cost snapshots. The model name is the llm_usage payload's attributes_model label.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (attributes_model) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_model!="" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: LLM cost by model (Top 20)

panels.description: Top 20 agents by windowed usage-time LLM cost snapshots.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="llm_usage", agent_id!=""} | json | category="telemetry" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: LLM cost by agent (Top 20)

panels.description: Mean percentage of discarded conversation characters retained in the replacement summary. The completed event is emitted where the history replacement is applied, not when a compact request or agent-authored summary is created; empty histories omit the ratio rather than manufacturing a zero denominator. event_name='compaction_completed', category='telemetry'.

targets.expr: avg(100 * avg_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | unwrap attributes_summary_history_ratio [$__interval]))

panels.title: Compaction ratio (summary/history)

panels.description: Applied history replacements per minute (5-minute buckets / 5). Counts compaction_completed rather than compact requests, so the series represents replacements that actually occurred. event_name='compaction_completed', category='telemetry'.
panels.title: Completed compactions (per minute)

panels.description: Agent-authored completed compactions / (agent-authored + hard automatic). Manual compact requests and events predating reminder attribution are excluded. Zero soft completions with hard completions is 0%; no completions is no data. The second ratio counts only agent-authored completions after a soft reminder: this is the preparation coverage target, so proactive compactions cannot hide missing plugin delivery. Neither ratio proves files were saved.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_compact_kind="compact_summary" | attributes_reminder_shown=~"true|false" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_compact_kind=~"compact_summary|auto" | attributes_reminder_shown=~"true|false" [$__range])))) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_compact_kind=~"compact_summary|auto" | attributes_reminder_shown=~"true|false" [$__range]))

100 * (sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_compact_kind="compact_summary" | attributes_reminder_shown="true" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_compact_kind=~"compact_summary|auto" | attributes_reminder_shown=~"true|false" [$__range])))) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service", event_name="compaction_completed"} | json | category="telemetry" | attributes_compact_kind=~"compact_summary|auto" | attributes_reminder_shown=~"true|false" [$__range]))

panels.title: Soft compactions (target >=95% after reminder)

panels.description: Ready-for-review to merge latency by complete cluster-tz day — median and p90 seconds, sampled by the daily PR-flow export job (scripts/ci/pull_requests/pr_flow_export.py) into the ava_pr_flow_daily_ready_to_merge_median_seconds / _p90_seconds gauges. One row per day; a day leaves the table once its last sample ages past the 26h lookback (a missed run shows as a gap).
panels.title: PR ready to merged — median / p90 (by day)

panels.description: Trunk merge-queue depth sampled once per PR-flow export run (ava_pr_flow_run_queue_depth_ratio gauge, macmini daily job). The run event is emitted even when Trunk is unreachable, so the breadcrumb survives an outage while the depth sample stays absent.
panels.title: Trunk queue depth

panels.description: Tests newly quarantined by Trunk’s flaky detector per complete cluster-tz day (ava_pr_flow_daily_flake_new_quarantines_ratio gauge, daily PR-flow export job). A day whose flaky source was unreachable is omitted rather than shown as zero.
panels.title: Flake — new quarantines (by day)

panels.description: Attributed CI wall time per completed PR by complete cluster-time day: median and p90 minutes. Zombie wall-clock artifacts, instant skips, and watchdog reruns are excluded from duration sums.
panels.title: Per-PR CI duration — median / p90 (by day)

panels.description: Attributed CI trigger count per completed PR by complete cluster-time day. The executed median filters instant-skip, watchdog, and proof workflows.
panels.title: Per-PR CI runs — median / p90 (by day)

panels.description: CI-red, rerun-to-green, failed retry, and v1 first-pass PR share by complete cluster-time day. First pass excludes watchdog, proof, instant-skip, and zombie runs.
panels.title: CI failures & self-healing (by day)

panels.description: Trailing-window workflow ranking by failures, run volume, completed-PR appearance, self-healing, and retry share. The explicit watchdog label keeps its designed noise filterable.
panels.title: Most fragile workflows (trailing window)

panels.description: The deduplicated white-run share and its instant-skip, superseded, abandoned, and retry components by complete cluster-time day.
panels.title: White-run classes (by day)
